-- Auction case-study demo constraints
-- Purpose:
--   * show invariants that should PASS for the supplied auction case study
--   * show intentionally false invariants that should FAIL
--   * include a runtime-sensitive invariant over C09 ObservablePropertySnapshot
--
-- Load this file only after the Auction native model is active.
-- The two DEMO_FAIL invariants are intentionally wrong.

-- =========================
-- Expected PASS: static case-study structure
-- =========================

context Agent
inv PASS_AuctionHasFiveAgents:
    Agent.allInstances()->size() = 5

context Role
inv PASS_AuctionHasTwoRoles:
    Role.allInstances()->size() = 2

context Group
inv PASS_AuctionHasOneGroup:
    Group.allInstances()->size() = 1

context Scheme
